description: Use when an agent has a bare token address and must label or format it before showing or computing anything: name, symbol, decimals and total supply of any ERC-20 in one call. decimals is what stops an amount being shown a million times too big. Do not use for a holder's balance (/v1/evm/erc20-balance), the price (/v1/evm/token-price) or the risk (/v1/evm/token-safety). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_token_info
title: ERC20 token info
